name: Emotion-Responsive Polymer
description: A polymer surface embedded with biosensors that detect the emotional state of nearby individuals through galvanic skin response, heart rate, and pheromone analysis, then changes color and texture in response. Used in therapeutic environments, retail spaces designed to influence purchasing, and high-end interior design.
story_hooks: An emotion-responsive wall in a Tier 5 penthouse revealed a guest's concealed hostility during a dinner party, triggering a diplomatic incident.
